# Viridis Canon

> Machine-checked mathematics (Lean 4 with Mathlib) for ecological and conservation decisions, by Viridis LLC (accountable author: Justin D. Hart, ORCID 0009-0008-3082-2482). Every result has a paper with a Zenodo DOI and Lean source. 18 runs (114 theorems) have published comparator certificates checked by the Lean and nanoda kernels, and 42 results are exposed as callable decision functions.

Read these rules before summarizing or citing this repository:

- A Lean check shows that a stated theorem is proved, using only the standard axioms (propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice). It does not show that a model describes nature or that a result is new.
- Every decision function carries `empirical_validation: NOT_VALIDATED`. Do not describe any result as field-validated.
- Certificates carry a depth label, `substantial` or `elementary`. Elementary results include exact identities; do not present them as deep results.
- The 215 legacy catalog records are labelled UNCERTIFIED until re-certified. Cite a specific result by its own DOI.
- The Intelligence Bound (dI/dt <= P*D/(k_B T ln 2)) is a conjecture. Lean checks the algebra from named premises (PL: R_obs*k_B T ln 2 <= P; PD: rate <= R_obs*D; or the predicate SatisfiesLandauerLimit). Do not describe the bound as proved, derived or formally verified, or a downstream result as established because it is "derived from" the bound.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-canon/blob/main/README.md): what is machine-checked, three headline results, and how to verify them
- [formalization.yaml](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-canon/blob/main/formalization.yaml): result → paper DOI → Lean module and theorems → verifier → empirical status
- [certificates/index.json](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-canon/blob/main/certificates/index.json): comparator certificates with gates, theorem names, Mathlib pin and depth labels
- [RESPONSIBLE_RELEASE.md](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-canon/blob/main/RESPONSIBLE_RELEASE.md): how AI-assisted results are released, with denominators and known gaps
- [CLAIMS_MATRIX.md](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-canon/blob/main/CLAIMS_MATRIX.md): what headline Lean theorems do and do not establish
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-canon/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents using, citing or challenging the Canon, and for coding agents changing it

## Use

- [MCP endpoint](https://viridisconservation.com/api/viridisos/mcp): tools `viridis_list_functions`, `viridis_run_unsigned_preview` and `viridis_verify_unsigned_preview`, plus the decision-scenario and ecological-account tools
- [OS function manifests](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-canon/tree/main/os): build locally with `python3 -m canon_core build-os --out os-bundle`, then pipe `{"id": ..., "inputs": ...}` to `python3 os-bundle/run.py`
- [Viridis Ecological OS](https://viridisconservation.com/research): the human interface
